content: बोधन {%a.%} [बुध्-णिच् ल्यु-ल्युट् वा] .²1 Informing, acquainting. .²2 Explaining, indicating. .²3 Arousing, waking. .²4 Kindling, inflaming. .{@-नः@} The planet Mercury (बुधः); बुध इव शिशिरांशोर्बोधनस्येव देवः <ls>V. 5. 21</ls>. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Informing, teaching, instruction, giving a knowledge of; भयरुषोश्च तदिङ्गितबोधनम् <ls>R. 9. 49</ls>. .²2 Denoting, signifying. .²3 Arousing, awakening; समयेन तेन चिरसुप्तमनोभवबोधनं सममबोधिषत <ls>Śi. 9. 24</ls>. .²4 Observing, perceiving. .²5 Waking, being awake. .²6 Making attentive. .²7 Burning incense. .{@-नी@} .²1 The eleventh day in the bright half of Kārtika when Viṣṇu rises from his four monthsʼ sleep; शयनीबोधनीमध्ये या कृष्णैकादशी भवेत् . सैवोपोष्या गृहस्थेन नान्या कृष्णा कदाचन <ls>Tithyādi.</ls> .²2 Long pepper. .²3 Understanding, knowledge.
